programmes.d: A Wyoming rancher's (Ernest Borgnine) wife eyes a drifter (Glenn Ford), and her ex-lover (Rod Steiger) tells her husband.
Farm boy Billy Bonney (Michael J. Pollard) rebels in 1870s Kansas and goes on to become Billy the Kid.
A federal agent (George Montgomery) and two colleagues infiltrate a gang of gold-rush gold smugglers.
After lying about being a stuntman, a blowhard (Buck Jones) gets the chance to prove himself to a movie studio.
An undercover U.S. marshal (Randolph Scott) and a crooked rancher follow an outlaw (Forrest Tucker) to stolen gold.
A Texas marshal (James Stewart) and a cavalry officer (Richard Widmark) recover long-held captives from Comanches.
A cowgirl vigilante (Wanda Hendrix) proves to a deputy (Lon McCallister) that the sheriff (Preston Foster) is an outlaw.
The scout's grandson (Bill Elliott) foils land-grabbers; his sidekick (Dub Taylor) flirts with twins.
The inhabitants of a small western community turn on Jim Guthrie (Dana Andrews) when he becomes the prime suspect for a murder he didn't commit.
A Confederate plot to turn the Sioux against the Union crumbles when a double agent makes off with a shipment of gold.
One bank robber (David Brian) double-crosses another (Neville Brand), giving the undertaker and others a chance at the loot.
Two Confederates (Joe Namath, Jack Elam) save a man's (Woody Strode) life and cause trouble in 1865 Missouri.
Jess Collins, a poor miner, helps Sonny chase off two men he calls claim jumpers. When he arrives in the nearby town, he learns Sonny is no good and everyone in town is against him.
An Arizona land-grabber (Telly Savalas) and his brother (George Maharis) renew their feud amid Army troops and Apaches.
A bounty hunter's need for vengeance emerges when he learns the outlaw he's escorting is related to his wife's killer.
A gunfighter (Randolph Scott) turns cowhand and then back again, fighting a cattle baron with two daughters (Barbara Britton, Dorothy Hart).
